Partner brief

Beog-Zaadba.
The next generation.

Private primary school · Komsilga · Burkina Faso

Opened on 1 October 2023 on the initiative of Yves Ferdinand KABORE. The brief describes three classrooms, an office, a storeroom and a working borehole.

Four areas for support

  • Room to grow — Improve sanitation, prepare three new classrooms and secure the school grounds.
  • Learning with confidence — Textbooks, learning materials and better equipment for the team.
  • A place for every child — A pooled education support fund and a proposed community canteen.
  • Learning by doing — Gardening, poultry keeping and age-appropriate introductions to practical skills.

Two priorities to prepare

Sanitation: estimated at 4,510,000 FCFA. Building and furniture: estimated at 40,735,500 FCFA for the intended 2027 school year. Planning figures as of 1 October 2026, including contingencies; quotations and approval required.

All projects are in preparation. No payments are accepted. Official contact details are to be confirmed with school leadership.
